notes.title: Bleaklight Falls Demo Patch 0.1.1
notes.notes: [h3]Content[/h3][p]While playing in the forest, you may now stumble across unusual piles of dirt. If you dig up these piles, you may find treasure chests, rare golden treats, angry stone crabs, or even a golden stone crab that will drop rare materials and a guaranteed Unique item![/p][p][/p][h3]QoL Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Meelu now has a Stash in his bedroom where he can store extra gear and consumables.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now mark gear as Locked or Junk. Locked gear cannot be salvaged or dropped.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Salvage All option for all Junk gear, which is selected by default.[/p][/*][*][p]Added tooltips for Alteration Stats, Game Difficulty option, and a few other places.[/p][/*][*][p]You can use the Unstuck button in Options -> Misc if you find yourself trapped somewhere.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a pathfinding issue for monsters in some tower configurations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue with Special Abilities associated with Unique items disappearing from your Hotbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed weapon remaining in Swap Slot when points are taken out of Weapon Swap Mastery.[/p][/*][*][p]Fix for sometimes appearing in a black screen when falling asleep in the forest.[/p][/*][*][p]And additional minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list]
